meta.title: ProArq: compare construction suppliers
meta.description: Search construction materials from suppliers in China, India, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam. Compare price, minimum order and lead time, then request quotes.

home.title: Construction materials from five countries, compared line by line.
home.lead: Search products from suppliers in China, India, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam. Put price, minimum order and lead time next to each other, then request quotes from the ones that fit.
home.describe: Describe your project to the assistant

search.title: Search or describe what you need
search.body: Type a material, or tell the assistant about your project in plain words.

compare.title: Compare offers line by line
compare.body: Add up to four products and read price tiers, minimum order, lead time and certifications in one table.

quote.title: Request quotes from the suppliers you pick
quote.body: Send one request per supplier and follow every answer from your account.

catalog.noResultsBody: Try removing a filter or searching for a broader term.

compare.title: Compare products
compare.full: You can compare up to {max} products. Remove one to add another.
compare.emptyBody: Use the Compare button on any product card. You can compare up to four products side by side.
compare.notFoundTitle: These products are no longer in the catalog
compare.notFoundBody: The link may be old. Search again and pick new products to compare.
compare.addOneMore: Add at least one more product to see the differences.
compare.bestHint: Best value in each row is marked.
compare.differentUnits: Sold in different units: not compared.

ai.title: Purchase analysis
ai.lead: AI reads this table and lists the best options with their pros and cons. Uses one of your {limit} daily assisted requests.
ai.disclaimer: Generated by AI only from the data in this table. Confirm prices and terms with each supplier before buying.
ai.signIn: Sign in to get an AI purchase analysis.
ai.limit: You have used your {limit} assisted requests for today. Try again tomorrow.
ai.unavailable: The analysis is not available right now. The comparison table above is still complete.

supplier.sourceNote: Public company profile compiled from <link>Wikidata</link>, an open database. This company is not a ProArq member and has not been verified. We have no prices or products from it.

footer.about: ProArq helps builders and architects compare construction suppliers across countries before they buy.
footer.sample: Demo catalog: suppliers, products and prices are sample data.

error.title: We could not load this page
error.body: The catalog did not answer. Your search is safe; try again in a moment.

notFound.title: This page is not in the catalog
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

account.title: Your account
account.profileLead: This information is sent to suppliers with each quote request.
account.countryHint: Two letters, for example AR or US.
account.noFavoritesBody: Save products from their page to find them here later.
account.noRfqsTitle: You have not requested any quotes yet
account.noRfqsBody: Open a product and choose Request a quote.

errors.companyTooLong: The company name is too long.
errors.countryInvalid: Use two capital letters, for example AR.
errors.messageRequired: Write a message for the supplier.
errors.quantityInvalid: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
errors.quantityBelowMin: The quantity is below this supplier's minimum order.
errors.rateLimited: You have sent many quote requests in the last hour. Please try again later.
errors.invalid: Something went wrong. Please check the form and try again.

assistant.title: Describe what you need
assistant.lead: Write the material, quantity, budget and where you prefer to buy from. The assistant picks real products from the catalog and tells you why each one fits.
assistant.label: Your request
assistant.placeholder: e.g. 500 m² porcelain tile from Vietnam, cheapest
assistant.hint: Up to {max} characters. Works in English or Spanish.

examples.tiles: 500 m² porcelain tile from Vietnam, cheapest
examples.cement: 200 bags of portland cement, urgent, not from China

assistant.offTopicTitle: I can only help with construction materials
assistant.offTopicBody: Name a material, for example tiles, cement, rebar, faucets or LED lights. You can add quantity, budget and countries.
assistant.aiSignIn: Signed-in buyers can have the assistant interpret free-form requests.
assistant.aiLimit: You have used your {limit} assisted requests for today. Name a material to keep searching.
assistant.aiAssisted: The assistant used AI to interpret your request. Check the criteria above.
assistant.resultsTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No recommendations} one {# recommendation} other {# recommendations}} out of {total, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}}
assistant.noResultsBody: Try a higher budget, more countries or fewer certifications, or adjust the filters in the catalog.

reasons.meetsMinOrder: Your quantity meets the minimum order
reasons.minOrderAboveQuantity: Minimum order is above your quantity
